content.rendered:
We are excited to share that our Hawks View Pre-K class is now open for registration! Our Pre-K is open to students who are age 4 on or before September 1, 2023. More information about our Pre-K program, and information about registration, can be found linked here. 

In addition, we will be holding a Pre-K Open House on Tuesday, March 7th from 4-5 pm. All families are welcome to attend to meet our Pre-K staff, tour our Pre-K classroom, and learn more about our Pre-K program! Families will enter through the main building entrance.  If you know of someone not receiving our Hawks View Updates that may be interested in attending, please pass along this information to them!
